name: Skeletal Champion Archer
body:
This skeletal figure stands and fires its bow as cold blue light shines in its eye sockets.

Skeletal Champion Archer

CR 2

XP 600
Human skeletal champion warrior 1
NE Medium undead
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+6 armor, +1 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 17 (3 HD; 2d8+1d10+3)
Fort +3 Ref +1 Will +3; channel resistance +4
DR 5/bludgeoning; Immune cold, undead traits

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee mwk longsword +4 (1d8+1/19–20)
Ranged longbow +6 (1d8/x3) or Rapid Shot +4/+4 (1d8/x3)

STATISTICS

Str 13, Dex 17, Con —, Int 9, Wis 10, Cha 12
Base Atk +3; CMB +4; CMD 17
Feats Improved InitiativeB, Point-Blank Shot, Rapid Shot, Weapon Focus (longbow)
Skills Intimidate +7, Perception +6, Stealth –1
Gear breastplate, heavy steel shield, longbow with 40 silver arrows, masterwork longsword

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary, pair, or platoon (3–12)
Treasure standard (breastplate, heavy steel shield, masterwork longsword, other treasure)

Some skeletons retain their intelligence and cunning, making them formidable warriors. These undead are far more powerful than their mindless kin, and many gain class levels.
